body: REDGARDEN systemd服務都只是bot對戰pool(非訓練本身),沒有python訓練進程在跑。rl_team_checkpoints/最新檔案是2026-08-10 13:39(noisy-gestalt那次跑的),之後沒有新checkpoint。gpt2-alpine-c/checkpoints同樣沒有新模型(S26-04 Colab fine-tune仍是human-blocked,未變)。已啟動新訓練:--team-size 3 --autocurriculum --noisy-gestalt --total-timesteps 200000(比前次500000規模小,考量目前系統CPU load average~10/8核已偏高,先跑一個真正的end-to-end --autocurriculum驗證run而非直接複製前次規模),輸出到rl_team_checkpoints_autocurriculum/,背景執行中,Monitor持續追蹤。這是NORTHSTAR §26.3.1明確記錄的下一步('a real end-to-end run with --autocurriculum enabled hasn't happened yet')。
